## Paper

A Review of Design Principles for Community-based Natural Resource Management

## World

resource_island

## Institution

Natural-resource governance design principles.

## Agent type

Resource users / institution-governed learning agents.

## Theoretical benchmark

Operational design principles: boundaries, monitoring, sanctioning, conflict resolution, and local fit.

## Learning setup

Stylized Resource Island v1 layouts that create contested resources and measurable institution pressure.

## Metrics

Activation thresholds, property opportunities/violations, trade blocks, sustainability, welfare, survival.

## Main result

The design principles are well supported empirically and several important theoretical issues warrant discussion.

## What they prove

Do not treat this review card as a formal proof. It is used as a checklist for common-pool-resource design principles such as boundaries, monitoring, sanctions, conflict resolution, and local fit.

## What they only simulate

Not applicable for this card's thesis use: it is a review/synthesis source, not a simulation benchmark.

## What they do NOT test

Learning-agent implementations of property rights, unequal trade controls, activation thresholds, or neural/MARL behavior in artificial economies.

## What we need to reproduce

Check monitoring, boundaries, sanctions, and local incentive conditions through explicit v1 diagnostics.

## How our project differs

The paper reviews field governance principles. The repo implements minimal test hooks and should use the paper as a checklist, not as a validation claim.

## Implementation obligations

Contested resource layout; measurable non-owner opportunities; trade-price-control binding; reputation effects; explicit caveats for missing real governance features.

## Metrics to compare in our repo

Resource Island v1 contested layouts and activation thresholds; outputs/resource_island_v1_full.

## Failure modes to audit

Treating v0 inactive property rights as evidence; lacking monitoring/opportunity counters; price controls unable to bind due to one-for-one trades.

## Project code comparison

Compare A Review of Design Principles for Community-based Natural Resource Management to Resource Island v1 hardening. The repo has begun satisfying activation obligations but still lacks full institutional richness.
